summary: 1951 steel lookout on Tillamook County's Gobblers Knob, lowered in 1957; removed 1962 or abandoned 1965 per sources, with no remains described.

facts.design: steel tower with small cab (1951); lowered to 15 ft in 1957 with a larger cab and trailer house
facts.status_note: Removed in 1962 or abandoned in 1965, depending on the source; no source describes remains on the summit.

access.note: A hiking guide says most of the trail is easy gravel road in the Tillamook State Forest; undated user reports posted to the guide describe an impassable washout on the approach road.

visit.trail_note: Hiking guide lists a 7.7-mile route; the final climb to the summit is steep with loose gravel.

events.note: Register: 40-ft steel tower with small cab. firelookout.com: 34-ft tower with 7x7-ft cab. The heights differ between sources.

April 26, 1953 item from The Sunday Oregonian (quoted on the Oregon lookouts site) announces new construction including a secondary lookout on Gobbler's knob, two years after the register's build date.
Tower lowered to 15 ft; a larger cab and a trailer house were added.
firelookout.com and the Oregon lookouts site give 1965 as the abandonment year, against the register's 1962 removal.
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on November 6, 2019.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register: 1951 with a 40-ft tower. firelookout.com: 1951 with a 34-ft tower. A 1953 newspaper item on the Oregon lookouts site announces new construction on the knob. The story keeps the register's 1951 date and flags the 1953 item; the sources do not settle it.
Register says removed in 1962; firelookout.com and the Oregon lookouts site say abandoned in 1965. Both dates are given in the story, not chosen between.
Register gives 3,052 ft (930 m); the hiking guide gives 3,054 ft. Both are mentioned in the story.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on tower height (40 ft register vs 34 ft firelookout.com), on the build year (1953 newspaper item announces construction two years after the register's 1951), and on the end year (1962 removal vs 1965 abandonment). Hiking guide elevation 3,054 ft differs from the register's 3,052 ft. The guide's user reports are undated. No staffing information was found. The register page credits photos to the Howard Verschoor collection, but image URLs were not returned by fetch_text, so none are listed. Brief record dates (1951 built, 1962 removed, 2019 registered) match the register.
